item: 28.10b query/document embedding sides (nomic prompts, BGE query instruction A/B)
decision: Ship the query/passage split and the passage-side fixes; keep every model unprompted (BGE instruction off, nomic prompts off) until recall's top-20 rescoring window and top_k-dependent candidate pool are fixed, then re-measure nomic prompts.

method.corpus: dogfood-recall, 57 questions, snapshot benchmarks/dogfood-recall/data/snap-prefix (BGE) and two nomic re-embeds of it (232 memory records)
method.search: exact-scan builds (BRUTE_FORCE_MAX = usize::MAX): the shipped HNSW graph is OS-RNG seeded and rebuilt per process, so HNSW runs vary run to run; the exact build repeated identically
method.k: k10 = --fetch 10 (what an agent asking for 10 results gets); k25 = the harness default, whose ranking differs because recall's candidate pool grows with k
method.nomic_off: store embedded by a pre-28.10b build (no prompts)
method.nomic_on: store embedded with search_document:, queries with search_query:

nomic_prompts.why_fused_recall_loses: CLI recall rescores only the top 20 pre-QTC candidates (0.7*best_chunk + 0.3*fused); recency fills that window with new commits, and the prompts raise distractor cosines (e.g. 0.623 -> 0.658) enough to push old answers (vector rank 1) out of it
nomic_prompts.longmemeval: not measured: embed_batch_impl pads a whole batch to its longest text, and nomic's 8192-token window OOM-kills the process on a 16 GB machine

unchanged_for_shipped_config: all prefixes are empty, so every embedding is byte-identical to before; needle gate 31/31 recall@5 1.000, retention 1.000
